statements.statement: CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered
Patient has recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55)
Patient has personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
The concern is for intermittent arrhythmia
Prolonged monitoring is required to correlate the patient's symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances
Shorter-duration monitoring cannot capture these intermittent, symptom-correlated events
The ordered telemetry is medically necessary
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
